lines.en: Good. I need a place that has storage, because I have many books.

lines.en: That’s fine. Is there a deposit that I have to pay first?

lines.en: Yes, it’s the money that you pay before you move in. It is four weeks of rent.

facts.big: A flat that has a balcony
facts.label: Descrever com that
facts.sub: Use that para ligar uma coisa à informação: a flat that has a balcony. Para pessoas, who: the agent who helps me. Não repita o sujeito.

facts.label: Um apartamento que…
facts.sub: Use that para ligar uma coisa à informação: I want a flat that has a balcony. O that fica no lugar do sujeito, então não repita he, she ou it. A frase fica mais precisa.

facts.label: Pessoas que…
facts.sub: Para pessoas, use who ou that: the agent who helps me, the people who live there. Para coisas, use that ou which. Esse uso é muito comum quando se descreve algo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: That can connect a noun to more information.
items.why: Yes: a flat that has a balcony.

items.s: We say “a flat who has a balcony.”
items.why: For things, we say that or which.

items.s: For people, we can say who or that.
items.why: Yes: the people who live there.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: That can connect a noun to more information. → Verdadeiro (Yes: a flat that has a balcony.)
We say “a flat who has a balcony.” → Falso (For things, we say that or which.)
For people, we can say who or that. → Verdadeiro (Yes: the people who live there.)

“Good morning, Mia. What kind of flat are you looking for?” says Earl. “I’m looking for a flat that has a balcony and a nice view.” says Mia. “I have one that is close to the river. It has a lift that works well.” says Earl.
